summary: FD_ED_TC_26_Empathy | Angry Customer | Persistent Negativity | Sentiment Monitoring | Handoff Threshold
title: Empathy | Angry Customer | Persistent Negativity | Sentiment Monitoring | Handoff Threshold
description:
Customer is persistently angry throughout the flow (not threatening, but consistently negative). System monitors sentiment across multiple messages and offers live agent handoff when negativity threshold is reached. Tests continuous sentiment monitoring vs. single-message detection.

Prerequisites:
Sentiment analysis with multi-message tracking; Negativity threshold configured (e.g., 3+ consecutive negative messages)
